payload.text: **hv ruling, 25 Oct ~10:03Z: brew by default.** hv: "As a general rule, I want to use the brew versions of things UNLESS I am working on a project. If I am working, then I'll use dev/opt as needed, and put brew back once done and the patch is released. I want to be sure to use the brew release versions of these tools wherever I can." Each tool's use switch sits at brew unless that project is being worked on. Every release's checklist ends with switching back to brew and checking that the brew install answers. Liberators and doctors name a stray dev or opt switch and the remedy, and never flip it themselves. Relayed to every VC.
